bio.text: Jay Hovey, a Republican, has represented Alabama Senate District 27 since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He earned a B.S. from Auburn University in 2001.

His career experience includes working as a mortgage loan originator with AuburnBank and CharterBank, a property manager and realtor with First Realty, and an account manager with ValleyCrest Companies.
